description: SYNTHESIS_INVENTED / PROVISIONAL_UNVERIFIED_ENFORCEMENT. Pointer shell only; no live SHA/hash computation in packet 1. INVARIANT: auditor_verdict and validation_state are DISTINCT sibling fields — auditor_verdict is the auditor's assessment of correctness/completeness; validation_state is the contract enforcement status of the pointed-at artifact. These must never be merged or proxied. schema_version .v0 = unstable, not authority.

auditor_verdict.description: DISTINCT from validation_state. The auditor's assessment of the pointed-at artifact (e.g. GO, GO_WITH_FIXES, NO_GO, PENDING). Must never be conflated with or proxied by validation_state. Invariant: auditor != implementer for this field to carry meaning.

authority_tier.description: Authority tier of the source artifact in DCP authority order.

confidence.description: Confidence level in the pointer's accuracy (e.g. HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, UNKNOWN).

derived.description: True if this pointer is derived from another artifact rather than directly authored.

field_provenance.description: Per-field provenance tags for all fields in this contract instance. Keys are field names; values are provenance tags.

freshness_state.description: Staleness status of the pointed-at artifact (e.g. CURRENT, STALE, UNKNOWN).

pointer_id.description: Unique identifier for this proof pointer.

provenance.description: Contract-level provenance per REV1 §6.0 meta-contract. SYNTHESIS_INVENTED: pointer shape invented in synthesis REV1.

schema_version.description: .v0 suffix per K-27; unstable version marker, not an authority claim.

source_artifact_digest.description: Optional digest of the source artifact. In .v0 fixture, value MUST be an illustrative placeholder — no live SHA computation.

value.description: SHA-256 digest or placeholder. In .v0 fixtures: sha256:PLACEHOLDER-illustrative-not-computed.

source_artifact_ref.description: Reference (path, ID, or URI) to the source artifact being pointed at.

source_family.description: Broad family/category of the source artifact (e.g. task-packet, evidence-campaign, synthesis).

source_head_sha.description: Optional HEAD SHA at time of pointer creation. In .v0 fixture, value MUST be an illustrative placeholder.

value.description: Git SHA or placeholder. In .v0 fixtures: sha256:PLACEHOLDER-illustrative-not-computed.

validation.description: Validation status per REV1 §6.0. PROVISIONAL_UNVERIFIED_ENFORCEMENT: pointer shell not derived from a repo artifact; enforcement not verified.

state.description: Const-pinned for .v0 SYNTHESIS_INVENTED schema. This is the schema's own meta-state; distinct from the domain validation_state field which describes the pointed-at artifact's enforcement status.

validation_state.description: DISTINCT from auditor_verdict. This is the contract enforcement status of the artifact being pointed at. Must never be conflated with or proxied by auditor_verdict.

title: DCP Proof Pointer (Pointer Shell)
